about: PERFORMANCE PARTS. Each group is one slot on the car; a car has at most one option from a group fitted.
Options are listed from mild to wild. Nothing fitted = the factory part.
"perEngine": true  -> the choice belongs to the ENGINE: swap the engine and the other engine keeps its own parts.
What an option may change (src/vehicles/carSetup.js applies them, nothing else is allowed):
torque      x  the whole torque curve
redline     +  rpm: the top of the curve is stretched up to the new red line
boost       forced induction: torque x (1 + boost). A turbo gives it from "spool" rpm upward
(less below: lag); a supercharger gives it everywhere. "kind" must be one the engine
lists under "fits" in engines.json. An engine that is turbocharged from the factory
only gets "factoryTurboShare" of the boost (the kit replaces the turbo it already has).
"size": how big the turbo sounds (1 = normal; bigger = louder, lower whistle and blow-off).
mass        x  the car's weight        grip    x  tyre grip        brakeG  x  braking force
shiftTime   =  seconds without drive during a gear change (factory: 0.14)
extraGear   adds one more gear on top: that ratio = the old top gear x this number
efficiency  =  share of engine power that reaches the wheels (factory: 0.88)
The names players see are in names.json under "parts".
